docs.text: Sixteen years after we landed on the moon, explorers reached the deepest point in the Great Lakes. Forty years later, we’re going back. We’re teaming up with .bsky.social on June 6 at 1 PM ET to send an underwater drone down to livestream everything we see: GreatLakesNow.org/HiddenBelow
We’re on our way to Superior Maximus, the deepest point in the Great Lakes. Watch the livestreamed expedition TODAY at 11 AM ET: www.greatlakesnow.org/hiddenbelow/

Ever wondered what’s hiding in the deepest, darkest corners of the Great Lakes? We’re teaming up with .bsky.social to send an underwater drone to the deepest known point in the Great Lakes on June 6 at 1 PM ET and livestream what we find. See you there: www.facebook.com/events/10001...

Our Superior Maximus ROV dive to the deepest point in the Great Lakes is being postponed due to rough weather conditions. The good news? We're now planning to go live TOMORROW, June 7 at 11 AM ET. Sign up for our newsletter to get a heads up before we go LIVE: www.greatlakesnow.org/great-lakes-...

Today's livestreamed expedition has been rescheduled for TOMORROW at 11 AM ET due to weather conditions. We'll still be descending more than 1,330 feet into the deepest, darkest depths of the Great Lakes to see what lives there. Stream it TOMORROW at 11 AM ET: www.greatlakesnow.org/hiddenbelow/

The deepest point in the Great Lakes is about to be explored LIVE. Come along on the search for deepwater sculpin, giant siscowet trout, colourful hydra, and perhaps even the elusive kiyi- never photographed alive in its natural habitat. Planned live dive: June 6 at 1 PM
Weather window: June 6–9
"Superior Maximus" 🤔 I suppose this is still the USA and "Profundus Maximus" for "deepest Lake Superior" wasn't a hook.
It’s a beautiful day here at Superior Maximus! We’ll be diving to the deepest depths of the Great Lakes at 11:00am ET. Join us live: inspiredplanet.ca/hidden-below...
